request: Use a team to think about the best solution

reviewers.critic_redteam: target variance, horizon, and control-variate failure

method: Independent read-only analyses followed by direct peer critique; no extra baseline jobs launched for deliberation
findings: Unit future Hermite controls increased residual variance; calibrated snapshots produced negligible reduction. These controls predict little useful future return noise.
Frozen lambda also changes continuation distribution and removes roughly 65 within-burst bootstrap refreshes. Lambda itself is not isolated as stability or underperformance cause.
Current LAP/Huber Hermite loss is not a proper unweighted conditional Gaussian moment projection. Missing Huber constant affects reported values, not gradients away from threshold.
Integral-only early results are mixed across matched training/evaluation points; structural consistency is plausible, sustained superiority unproven.
v9 mean JVP includes latent mean, preaction, and SALE action-embedding paths. No missing chain-rule bug found.
Same-state action coverage remains limited; neither exact integration nor low training loss establishes gradient accuracy.
Refreshed lambda v20 was stopped at 1.048M; approximately1665 training at1M did not rescue early performance. No final8M conclusion follows.

first_candidate.method: Distribution-native latent critic with fixed physical action basis and exact clipped-Gaussian expectations
first_candidate.basis: state/SALE-conditioned intercept + 6 linear coefficients + 21 symmetric quadratic coefficients + 30 hinge coefficients (five interior knots per joint)
first_candidate.meaning: m1,m2 and hinge moments computed for componentwise clipped Gaussian actions. Values and actor derivatives share one model without Monte Carlo actor evaluations.
first_candidate.target: Retain lambda horizon and behavior-consistent target-update recipe; use v20 evidence to choose refresh policy explicitly
first_candidate.objective: Proper conditional-mean squared-error return regression, uniform or exact sampling-probability compensation. Treat architecture+objective as a deliberate package, not isolated one-factor evidence.
first_candidate.preserve: SALE state representation, fixed action basis/scaling, original actor/encoder cadence and environment-step budget
first_candidate.guarantee: Exact internal distribution/point/gradient consistency only; no guarantee of learned accuracy or higher returns
first_candidate.risk: Small behavior sigma weakly excites curvature; hinges can be inactive or collinear; cross-joint nonlinearity beyond quadratic may exceed capacity
first_candidate.prediction: Better independent action-credit calibration and benchmark returns if free latent-coordinate inconsistency is limiting. An automatically zero convolution error is not evidence of accuracy.
first_candidate.status: Reviewed design; trainer not implemented or submitted during team deliberation

second_candidate.method: Genuine paired same-state action branches with shared future policy noise
second_candidate.purpose: Observe return differences to identify first-action effects while reducing shared continuation noise
second_candidate.accounting: Count all branch simulator transitions in total benchmark interaction budget; correctly restore full simulator and time-limit state
second_candidate.condition: Prioritize if actor-facing gradients remain inaccurate despite consistent analytic model
